source.upstream: Maton ActiveCampaign Marketing Automation & CRM skill

description: A real ActiveCampaign Marketing Automation & CRM API skill for managed-OAuth access to contacts, lists, automations, campaigns, deals, tasks, tags, and email tracking.
authorization_notes: Campaign send is irreversible; confirm campaign content, target list, and subscriber count before sending.
Automation entry adds a contact to a triggered workflow; confirm the automation name and intended effect on the contact with the user.
Deal creation in CRM represents financial commitments; confirm deal value, stage, and contact association before creating.
Contact sync and creation affect marketing consent status; do not change subscription status without explicit user direction.
Deal management creates financial records; ensure deal amounts and stages are verified with the user before writing.
